newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 edges down on Jambi.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 edges down on Jambi.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged down in late trading on Monday following foreign buying in Jambi, dealers said.
Dealers said February SIR20 offer prices fell 0.25 cents/lb to 54.75-55.25 cents/lb fob Medan, 54.50-55.00 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang, 54.00-54.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"We expect to see more deals today following fresh enquiries from Europe and the United States," one Jakarta dealer said.
February SIR20 was last bought at 54.00 fob Jambi after the lunch break on Monday, dealers said.
Dealers said foreign firms also bought February SIR20 fob Surabaya and fob Palembang at 54.50 cents late on Friday.
January SIR3CV fob Medan was on offer at 142 cents/kg, up from the previous 141, they said.
Latex dealers said high amoniac latex was on offer at 2,230 rupiah/kg fob Medan for January shipments.
